turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I buy a laptop now or wait for the sales?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Prices usually drop in about three weeks. Can you get by with your current one until then, or do you need it right away?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One moment, my sister is asking me something. Please don't interrupt until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Zoe, can you help me move the air mattress into the office?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Is your cousin really staying for ten days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you take the trash out?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet, I'll do it now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Apparently. She says it's cheaper than a hotel.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Well, it is. Does she know about the cat?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no. She's allergic, isn't she?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Very. You should probably tell her tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah. I'll call her after dinner.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Welcome back. We were working out whether you can wait for the laptop sales.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can wait. My old one is slow but it still works.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good, then set a price alert and grab it when it drops.
